# What CMF does not do yet

- **Hiding is one-way.** A hide claim cannot be overruled by another pack's "show" claim, and the HUD minimap still shows hidden pins, except a type hidden everywhere when the player has the minimap add-on 2.1.0 (below). Text another mod writes into a tooltip (such as Map Quest Insight's "Also here") can still name a hidden pin.

- **Conflicts follow folder names, or CMF's own order setting.** The load order a player sets in a mod manager or `mods.settings` does not change which pack wins inside CMF. Names are compared ignoring capital letters, like the game's own folder order. A player can put packs first by name in CMF's settings ([section 11](For-Players.md)). This ran in game on 2026-10-20.
- **CMF does not watch the options menu.** When a mod's own setting changes, the mod registers again at the next map opening, as [section 9](Shipping-Your-Mod.md#9-ship-it) shows under [Packs with settings or text](Shipping-Your-Mod.md#packs-with-settings-or-text). CMF prepares its winners again only when a registration actually changed. A change made while the map is open applies at the next opening. The settings launch (2026-10-19) ran this: the test pack's toggle followed at the next map opening.
- **A shared legend row takes the first pin's icon.** Quest pins share one row; give them one legend image ([section 6](Choosing-Pin-Types.md)).
- **A bad image path falls back to the stock icon.** CMF logs `art failed` for it; the pack tool's check catches paths into your own cache before you ship.
- **A legend row shared by several types** (quest pins) takes the first pin's tint, as it does the first pin's icon.
- **Pins other mods push** (no `AddPinTypeData`) take their legend tint from the legend name (`filteredType`) only, unless the row's image came from the pin's own type.
- **Level variants** (`_1` to `_3`) cannot have their own images; the base type's image covers them.
- **No new pin types** (legend rows, row names and tabs come with API version 2, and pin labels with API version 4, [section 5](Writing-Your-Script.md#5-write-your-script)), and no changes to player-placed pins. The player arrow can only be hidden (API version 9), and the world overview takes new pictures but keeps its layout (API version 9, [section 5](Writing-Your-Script.md#5-write-your-script), [World overview pictures](World-Overview-Pictures.md)). The rest comes with later CMF stages. The HUD minimap shows your type-level icons and tints only when the player installs CMF's optional minimap add-on ([section 11](For-Players.md)); tag claims stay off the minimap.
